method: Actual local Ollama requests through running FastAPI; three sequential questions in one persisted session; provider context documented by prompt version; one run per case, not a variation study

cases.question: Do I have to watch a moving shape?

observed.text: You can choose Text only before or during the exercise. The inhale/exhale words and count still show the pace. Changing the cue does not restart pacing or save a remembered preference.

cases.question: What stays after I close this?

observed.text: The app attempts to save fictional questions, displayed replies, and session records in local SQLite. Check the save status; a failed save is not a stored record. Delete sessions and their conversations in History. Live mode sends the current question and limited context to the local Ollama model.
Pause holds the current phase and count. Resume continues them. End stops the exercise. Crisis support stays available, and opening it pauses an active exercise.
